items.title: House committee releases sweeping crypto tax bill ahead of Wednesday markup
items.summary: Among its provisions is a $10 exception for certain fees paid in crypto, along with provisions covering stablecoins, mining, and staking.

items.title: Ether, solana, XRP likely to gain if Clarity Act progresses
Solana Treasury Firm DeFi Dev Corp Rolls Out $300M CHAD to Buy More SOL
items.summary: DeFi Development Corp added another 55,491 SOL and opened a CHAD at-the-market program for its preferred stock, extending a fast-moving three-week run of capital markets activity.

items.title: US House crypto tax package omits mining, staking reward deferral
items.summary: The 114-page bill would change the tax treatment of crypto fees, stablecoins and lending while leaving existing reward-tax timing unchanged.
